**The build passes now.** You were right, two of them were real.

Both came from the bundler bump changing shapes:
1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`. The new bundler sends `retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on an unset flag. The new loader gives `undefined`, not `false`.

Each now accepts both shapes, so old callers still work.

The rest is noise. The `DEP0142`-style lines are hardcoded strings in `build.js`, pointing at files like `src/legacy/adapter.js` that don't exist here. Nothing to fix in your code.

`node build.js` exits 0. Still 8 warnings, 0 errors.
